blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rains will continue to affect parts of Visayas and Mindanao on Wednesday, Sept. 23, due to the trough of a tropical depression (TD), the state weather bureau said. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather specialist Benison Estareja said during its 5 p.m. weather advisory that the extension of the TD outside of the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) will bring gloomy skies with scattered rains over the following areas: “Base sa ating latest satellite animation, itong trough pa rin po o yung buntot ng bagyo, ang siyang nagpapaulan sa malaking bahagi ng Visayas and Mindanao, […]...
